history: Both previously viewed; exploratory reused validation after017. No independent test.
sources: Existing first-division Bundesliga IDSSE/Sportec, CC BY4.0, Bassek et al2025; provider BallStatus/BallPossession labels separate from observations
noise_selection: Fixed before any018 fit/evaluation, independent of challenge and labels; no estimation from provided game. Overlapping masks can form longer gaps.
other_conditions: Same short/long masks and train/validation seeds as017
training: one fixed estimator each for H/A and alive/dead, train clean/short/long/tracker_noise, live-only H/A with team swaps; same100 boosting iterations/15leaves/lr.08/minleaf40/l2=10/no earlystop; seed118; stride5
selection: Best four-condition mean spellF1 among variants with no aggregate increase in misses/merges/FP; each fold original clean/masked/long F1 no >.01 decline; each fold tracker_noise F1 no decline; each fold deadF1 no >.005 decline in every condition. No post-result sweep.
